Name: Salty's Camilla Portrait for SVE
Author: saltybleu
Description:
This is a high-res portrait for Camilla! You must have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded [/url]and use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999]Portraiture[/url] in order to properly use this.

[b][size=3]Installation Guide:[/size][/b][list=1]
[*]Unzip the main file
[*]Go to your mods folder or wherever you put the Portraiture folder.
[*]Move the png files to your Portraiture folder. The file path should look something like this: "Stardew Valley/Mods/Portraiture/Portraits/<whatever your folder is called>"
[/list]*note: I'm not actually sure what name it needs to be for Camilla's vendor portrait...

If you like this style, consider using my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32545]Wizard portrait[/url]﻿!! It's the only other one so far :D


[b][size=3]Credits:[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]FlashShifter and Poltergeister for Camilla
[/list]
